text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu...!
She has claimed the first Triple Tiara in history!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She really is strong—too strong, Mejiro Ramonu!
Will we ever see another Umamusume like her in the future!?
With a flawless run, Mejiro Ramonu takes the victory!"
(Waaaaaaah!!)

"The first-ever Triple Tiara achievement"—
At that historic moment, Mejiro Ramonu was...
She simply smiled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Lovely.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Shaking the very air—pure fervor.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A piercing scream—cutting straight into the skin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And...
a gush of—love.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu seems a bit different from usual...
Having achieved such a monumental feat, is she finally feeling relieved?
choice_data_list: (No, I'm sure she... wants to keep looking ahead)

text_block_list.text: I want to become even more perfect.
I want to run in even more magnificent races.
I want to compete with even stronger Umamusume.
More and more—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I want to love...
choice_data_list: (...We need to talk about our next goal!)

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't wait to see her next race...
With the lingering cheers at my back, I hurried down into the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...I can't reach her.
She's just too perfect.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: Nothing can reach her... Neither my feelings, nor my legs—

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: —Lady Ramonu! Congratulations on this historic achievement!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

I wasn't the only one waiting for Mejiro Ramonu after the race.
In an instant, she was surrounded by a swarm of reporters—

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've firmly secured your place in racing history,
please tell us how you honestly feel!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I was not the only one
who achieved this great feat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
You must have thoughts of your own that you wish to share, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"It's true that a trainer and Umamusume
work as a three-legged race. But..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...At first I thought she was remarkable,
but now her presence feels faint...
I'd rather hear Ramonu's story.

I can't read Mejiro Ramonu's intentions.
Is it to test me, or simply to bask in the lingering afterglow of the race...? Probably the latter.
choice_data_list: (Even so, the fact remains that it was entrusted to me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I've grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Far, faaar more than back when... I trembled at even the smallest steps...

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: I really want to hear your post-race thoughts straight from your own mouth, Mejiro Ramonu! Even if just for a few minutes—

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...
choice_data_list: I share the same feelings with her.

text_block_list.text:
"Saying it out loud made it feel undeniably true.
'We love racing'—
that was the sole bond connecting the two of them, after all."
choice_data_list: I can answer anything you want to know about Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? Then...
Please, go ahead and start, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave.
Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I will leave the rest in your capable hands,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Thank you for the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

And so, that day was consumed by handling the press...
Discussing our target races with Mejiro Ramonu
had to wait for another day.
